title.zh: 拨付三百万比索作为国家烟草公司追加资本的法案
title.en: An Act to Appropriate the Sum of Three Million Pesos as Additional Capital for the National Tobacco Corporation
title.orig: An Act to Appropriate the Sum of Three Million Pesos as Additional Capital for the National Tobacco Corporation

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1948/ra_302_1948.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury, the sum of three million pesos, as additional capital for the National Tobacco Corporation: Provided, That not more than twenty per centum shall be spent for salaries and wages.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1948.
